title: Sichuan Peppercorn Beef Burgers with Chilli-Ginger Mayo
changes_from_base: A toasted Sichuan peppercorn, cumin, fennel and star anise powder is scattered over the patties as they finish, served on toasted English muffins with chilli-ginger mayonnaise, quick cucumber pickles and coriander instead of cheese and lettuce.
summary: Fragrant toasted spices crust these juicy beef patties, whilst a bright chilli-ginger mayo and tangy cucumber pickle provide cooling contrast.
equipment: spice grinder or pestle and mortar
large heavy frying pan or griddle pan

ingredients.item: Sichuan peppercorns, black seeds and stalks picked out
fresh ginger, peeled and finely grated
beef chuck mince (about 20% fat), shaped into 4 patties
fine sea salt or table salt
small cucumber, thinly sliced and tossed with 1 tbsp rice vinegar and ½ tsp sugar

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast 1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns (picking out black seeds and stalks), 1 tsp dried chilli flakes, 1 tsp cumin seeds, ¼ tsp fennel seeds and 1 small star anise in a dry small pan over high heat for about 1 min until fragrant; grind to a powder and stir in 1 tsp light brown sugar.

steps.title: Mayo
steps.text: Stir together 115 g mayonnaise, 1 tbsp sambal oelek, 15 g finely grated fresh ginger and 2 tsp rice vinegar, then chill.

steps.title: Pickle
steps.text: Toss 1 small thinly sliced cucumber with 1 tbsp rice vinegar and ½ tsp sugar.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Press a dip into each of 4 beef chuck mince patties and season well with 1 tsp fine salt and ½ tsp ground black pepper.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Fry the patties in 10 ml oil in a hot heavy pan or griddle for about 4-5 min a side until 71 °C in the centre, scattering the spice powder over them in the last minute; rest 5 min.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Set the patties on the bases of 4 toasted English muffins, top with chilli mayo, cucumber pickles and 10 g coriander leaves and tender stalks, close and serve.

tips: Toast spices briefly until fragrant only—over-toasting turns them bitter.
Make the cucumber pickle up to 1 hour ahead; drain just before serving.
Scatter spice powder over patties in the final minute for warm, fresh flavour.
storage: Cooked patties can be refrigerated for 2 days; the spice blend and mayo keep separately in the fridge for 3-4 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
